newsitem.title: KENYA: Tanzanian shilling weakens versus dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling weakens versus dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling weakened against the dollar on Monday on rising demand for the scarce U.S. currency in the interbank market, commercial dealers said.

They said the central Bank of Tanzania posted the shilling at a commercial mean rate of 608.058, compared with 608.0283 on Friday. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 985.3611, from 985.921 on Friday.
Dealers said many banks were not selling dollars despite available demand.
They said banks had reduced their demand for government treasury bills, which meant demand was low for the local currency necessary for such purchases.
